name: keep a negative remainder and add at the next step instead of restoring
mechanism: subtract the divisor from the shifted remainder every step; if the result goes negative do not undo it -- emit a negative digit and ADD the divisor at the next step instead; a final fix-up converts the signed digits to an ordinary quotient
